publications.title: Course creators: captions as a starting point for lesson notes
publications.copy:
Course creators: an existing subtitle file can also be a useful starting point for lesson notes.

Choose the export for the job:

• Plain transcript: text to edit into reading notes.
• Timed transcript: text with timestamps so you can find a passage in the lesson.
• CSV cue sheet: a table for reviewing individual cues and timings.

Keep the original SRT/VTT for video playback. Review the words against the lesson and edit the transcript before sharing it; converting a file does not check accuracy or turn it into finished notes.

I’m the seller of Caption Cleanup Kit. It exports these formats from existing UTF-8 SRT/VTT files in an offline desktop-browser workspace. US$9 once, including a quick-start guide and samples. No subtitle uploads or subscription. It does not transcribe audio or translate speech.
